escopo.objetivo: Explicar como o sistema imune reconhece e controla vírus e fungos (inata e adaptativa) e como esses patógenos evadem a resposta.

autoral_excecao: O AnKing cobre interferons, NK, CTL e o CMV, mas não traz o que a aula ensina sobre fungos (parede como PAMP, inflamassoma → Th17/Th1, Th1 e Th17 × Th2 e Treg) nem a organização dos TLRs e do escape viral; busca em seções, palavra-chave e significado não achou esses cards.

fields.Text: Antigenic variation of influenza viruses occurs with changes to viral {{c1::hemagglutinin (HA)}} and {{c1::neuraminidase (NA)}}
fields.Extra:
- This is also how influenza viruses are named

- Antigenic shifts: exchange of RNA segments between humans and animals → radically new HA or NA types → pandemics
- Antigenic drifts: spontaneous mutations → slightly altered HA or NA types → epidemics

fields.Text: Antigenic shift is associated with {{c2::pan}}demics
fields.Extra:
- Pandemics span over continents/worldwide
- HA and NA undergo antigenic variation which allow for outbreaks resistant to previous vaccination
- Influenza viruses are named based on HA and NA types example H1N1

- Antigenic shift is the exchange of RNA segments between animal and human viruses which cause new HA or NA leading to pandemics
- Antigenic drift is the spontaneous mutation that create slightly altered HA or NA leading to epidemics

fields.Text: Antigenic variation can be due to antigenic {{c1::drift}} or antigenic {{c2::shift}}
fields.Extra:
- Antigenic shifts: exchange of RNA segments between humans and animals → radically new HA or NA types → pandemics

- Antigenic drifts: spontaneous mutations → slightly altered HA or NA typers → epidemics

fields.Text: Antigenic drift is associated with {{c2::epi}}demics
fields.Extra:
- Large spread within a given population (disease outbreaks limited to one area)

- HA and NA undergo antigenic variation which allow for outbreaks resistant to previous vaccination
- Influenza viruses are named based on HA and NA types example H1N1

- Antigenic shift is the exchange of RNA segments between animal and human viruses which cause new HA or NA leading to pandemics
- Antigenic drift is the spontaneous mutation that create slightly altered HA or NA leading to epidemics


- Small mutations only partly reduce immunity from earlier infections

fields.Text:
Fungi:
- opportunistic: {{c1::Aspergillus::A…}}, {{c1::Cryptococcus::C…}}, {{c1::Pneumocystis::P…}}
- primary: {{c2::Histoplasma::H…}}, {{c2::Blastomyces::B…}}, {{c2::Paracoccidioides::P…}}

- Opportunists cause disease in immunosuppressed people; primary fungi also in people with no apparent immunodeficiency
- Coccidioides is also primary

- Lack of TNF-α = lack of granuloma = lack of containment of tuberculosis
